privacy_policy_description: This Privacy Policy describes Our policies and procedures on the collection, use and disclosure of Your information when You use the Service and tells You about Your privacy rights and how the law protects You.
personal_data_usage: We use Your Personal data to provide and improve the Service. By using the Service, You agree to the collection and use of information in accordance with this Privacy Policy.
interpretation_text: The words of which the initial letter is capitalized have meanings defined under the following conditions.
account_definition: Account means a unique account created for You to access our Service or parts of our Service.
affiliate_definition: Affiliate means an entity that controls, is controlled by or is under common control with a party.
application_definition: Application refers to ElevatED, the software program provided by the Company.
company_definition: Company (referred to as either 'the Company', 'We', 'Us' or 'Our' in this Agreement) refers to ElevatED.
device_definition: Device means any device that can access the Service such as a computer, a cellphone or a digital tablet.
personal_data_definition: Personal Data is any information that relates to an identified or identifiable individual.
service_provider_definition: Service Provider means any natural or legal person who processes the data on behalf of the Company.
third_party_social_media_service_definit: Third-party Social Media Service refers to any website or social network where a User can log in or create an account to use the Service.
usage_data_definition: Usage Data refers to data collected automatically, either generated by the use of the Service or from the Service infrastructure itself.
you_definition: You means the individual accessing or using the Service, or the company, or other legal entity on behalf of which such individual is accessing or using the Service.

guidelines_rules_info: Welcome to our educational platform! To ensure a safe, respectful, and productive environment for all users, we have established the following guidelines. By participating in our platform, you agree to adhere to these rules.
respect_and_inclusivity_info: Be kind and respectful to others. Harassment, hate speech, discrimination, or any form of bullying will not be tolerated.
academic_integrity_info: Do not share or request unauthorized copies of course materials, plagiarize content, or engage in dishonest behavior.
responsible_ai_use_info: AI-generated content should be used ethically. Misleading, harmful, or deceptive AI-generated information is not allowed.
group_chat_etiquette_info: Stay on topic, be respectful, and avoid spamming. Personal attacks and inappropriate content are strictly prohibited.
commenting_on_course_videos_info: Comments should be constructive, relevant, and respectful. Do not post offensive or disruptive messages.
reporting_violations_info: If you notice any violations of these guidelines, please report them to the platform administrators.
consequences_for_violations_info: Users who violate these guidelines may receive warnings, have their content removed, or face account suspension.
guidelines_thanks: Thank you for being a part of our community. Let's work together to create a positive learning environment!
